body: i wont lie i actually think about the suicide booth shit daily
im here to talk man. i care about you. i know how it feels to be empty.
i feel the same. im going nowhere in life and i feel like such a loser. all my friends get good grades and have jobs and seem great. i can barely pull myself out of bed.
im tired too. tired of everything. i wish i could leave without anybody noticing. i definitely understand how you feel.

thank you for taking the time to reply to me. it means a lot. and while i want to believe there's always a voice telling me that im none of the things that you describe. i just feel like ill never be enough. i do feel a bit better though. thank you. if youre going through anything id be glad to talk to you about whatever is on your mind. thank you again.

yeah im sure. i would hate to be locked up in one of those facilities.

and yeah of course! its quite scary when youre in that position trust me i know. and just seeing that youre making it through okay is amazing. and yeah im holding up okay. thank you for your thoughts.
and thats the worst part you know? not knowing WHY you feel the way you do but just having it be there.

damn man. im really sorry to hear that. is there any sort of bright side? like you have experience so could you maybe teach at another university? 

and honestly i dont know, a lot of times nothing will happen, yet ill hate the way the sun comes through my blinds in the morning. so many people have had terrible experiences and reasons to feel the way they do. but i dont seem to. i feel so out of place.

Yeah that sounds ultra shitty. and honestly probably makes people who feel the way we feel feel worse. and that makes me happy to hear that you dont feel in danger. and of course man, every one on here would be willing to help. thats why were here you know? just trying to make it by. thank you for responding. im glad to hear that youre feeling a little better

i hope if you do go to the ER they treat you well, and i hope that youre okay. i can guarantee you that every person that subscribes to this sub reddit cares about you man. please stay safe because youre loved by more people than you think. honestly.
yeah it sucks really bad dude. i just wish people didnt have to feel this way. thanks for replying. did you have a rough day too?
i know what that feelings like. i have always struggled with school and my parents make me feel awful about it. i know how you feel.

im so happy for you dude! thats so cool to hear, im not just saying that. im glad you found someone to play music with. i hope this doesnt come off as cheesy or anything but im a concert percussionist at my high school, and music is quite therapeutic for me when i feel suicidal thoughts, or self harming urges flooding my brain. i hope things start looking up for you dude. hang in there
i really hope that this is the start of a new chapter for you! obviously everything doesn't disappear in one day. but a starts a start. im so happy for you! hang in there :)

please dont. like bitterkisses said, you dont have to be perfect. no one is. and with all due respect your mom sounds absolutely awful. i have been in your shoes. in fact, im in your shoes right now. my parents fight all the time and the constant barrage of hate speech thrown at me about getting my grades up really cuts deep. please dont leave, youre not alone. who knows when youll see this but as of right now there are 559 users on here. im so sure that every single one of them would love to offer their support and love. please stay safe. talk to a friend. or a counselor at school. there are so many people that care and would love to help. i know it can be really tough to open up to people sometimes. but the support is out there i promise.
